t: Kim Jong-un's Sister Rejects South Korean Medical Equipment Offer as Provocation - State Media
d: Kim Yo-jong, the sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un and a department director at the Central Committee of the Workers’ Party, on Thursday called South Korea's offer of medical equipment to North Korea a provocation and an insult.

t: Russia Monitoring EU's Militaristic Activities to Prepare Appropriate Response
d: Russia is monitoring the EU's militaristic activities in order to prepare appropriate response measures, Vladislav Maslennikov, the chief of the Department of European Issues at the Russian Foreign Ministry, told Sputnik.

t: Ukrainian Conflict Requires Comprehensive Solution - Kremlin
d: The Ukrainian conflict requires a comprehensive solution, fragmented agreements will not lead to peace, Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said on Thursday.

t: Putin Arrives in Turkmenistan on Working Visit
d: The Russian leader plans to take part in the meetings of the CIS Council of Heads of State and the Caspian Environmental Summit, as well as hold bilateral meetings with the presidents of Turkmenistan and Iran.
